p.i: Testes sæpe tuis æquoribus rates Fractæ, puniceo sanguine decolor Pontus, luctificis oppida subruta Flammis, captáque mœnia. Nónne obsessa vides littora milite Anglo cuncta, simul navibus obrutos Fluctus innumeris, vela minantia, Telorum strepitus graues, Ignémque Aeolio sulphure feruidum, Clades ferre tuis puppibus asperas Doctum? Nonne vides impavidas Ducum Mentes, exitium tuæ Gentis? Cerne piam pectore prouido Reginam, procerum consiliis sacris Erectam, ut trepidæ strenua patriæ Duris rebus opem ferat. Sic qui puppe sedens celsior imperat Nautarum pavidas sedulus excitat Mentes, si scopulos cautus, & Africi Vitat præcipites minas: Castigátque moras, quum maris impiger Iratí tumidos murmura tollere Fluctus, séque diem condere percipit Nimbis tristibus obrutum. Sic pastor vigiles sollicitat canum Prudens excubias, quum gregibus timet Infirmis, avidos quum trepidantibus Propellit stabulis lupos.

page.notes: The "Heu," at the lower right is set apart after the verse; read as printed. Some words in the verse are uncertain at the ends of lines because of the faded print and the show-through from the other side; the line "Iratí" and "Doctum?" may be misread.
